title: Native Alchemy Docs Hard Cutover Tasks
principles: Alchemy Website.Vite is the only current docs deployment owner.
Legacy resource deletion is one-time, exact-stage, fail-closed and never recreates DocsBuild.
Historical evidence is preserved but cannot satisfy current deployment admission.
Local, provider, hosted and publication claims remain separate.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Commit only after the focused cutover checks, documentation checks, exact candidate proof and full repository verification pass. Provider mutation requires separate named authority.
evidenceRequired: Exact beta.64 source and installed dependency ledger
Native-only current resource and policy search result
Sibling docs package memo invalidation proof
Exact equality proof for Preview and teardown concurrency groups
Cutover state/provider receipt or a bounded no-legacy-state receipt
Historical evidence preservation and current-admission exclusion proof

downstreamArtifactImpact.surface: Native resource, docs build and active deployment policy
downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: Focused type/tests, active-surface search, native plan fixture and full verification.
nonClaims: Local proof does not establish provider or hosted state.

downstreamArtifactImpact.surface: Architecture, runbook, automation and active intent
downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: bun run check:docs and bun run check:runbooks with path and lifecycle readback.
nonClaims: Historical evidence is preserved and not rewritten.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: Historical-path inventory and current-admission exclusion tests.
nonClaims: Historical DocsBuild observations are not current resource state.

downstreamArtifactImpact.surface: Public content, package exports, Changesets, release, skills and AGENTS.md
downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: Confirm no public API, package contract, release, skill or operating-loop change was introduced.
nonClaims: No package publication, versioning or external release is authorised.

tasks.title: Establish the exact beta.64 cutover baseline
tasks.goal: Record the native graph, installed versions, exact Alchemy source and current legacy-state decision before implementation.
outputs: updated SPEC/task evidence if the installed types change the design
no provider mutation receipt unless separately authorised
tasks.implementationPrompt: Review the SPEC call graphs and current architecture first. Use the installed beta.64 types and pinned source, not current beta.72 examples. Keep credentials and provider state read-only until a separately named operation is approved.
mandatoryVerification: Installed package and lockfile version inspection
Alchemy beta.64 source inspection for Website.Vite memo/workspace options
qualityAudits: Review the target call graph against alchemy.run.ts and the docs Vite host boundary.
Confirm no raw provider values, credential values, unchecked SDK values or generic child-process wrappers are introduced.
Record whether the existing active teardown plan is a dependency or must be amended.

parentAudit.basis: Review the source ledger, installed types, current state decision, call graph and SPEC before accepting implementation scope.
parentAudit.recovery: Correct the SPEC, re-scope the task or seek named authority when the installed API or state identity is not clear.

completionCriteria: The exact beta.64 memo option is evidenced.
The current native resource identity and legacy-state decision are recorded.
No provider mutation or external state claim is made without a receipt.

tasks.title: Perform the native-only legacy resource cutover
tasks.goal: Remove the old resource from admitted Alchemy state without recreating or retaining a current DocsBuild model.
tasks.implementationPrompt: Keep current repository admission native-only: reject DocsBuild create, update and noop, unknown resources, state/provider disagreement and identity mismatch. A separately authorised exact-stage operation may delete DocsBuild only when preflight proves it exists beside the matching DocsWebsite and must retain post-delete absence readback. This implementation thread performs no provider mutation or absence claim.
mandatoryVerification: Focused policy and Schema tests for native-only create/update/noop/delete cases
Exact-stage preflight and post-cutover state/provider readback when separately authorised
qualityAudits: Search active source, workflows, schemas, policy, fixtures and READMEs for DocsBuild and Command.Build.
Confirm historical JSON is not rewritten or used as current admission evidence.
Review rollback so it restores native DocsWebsite only and never recreates DocsBuild.

parentAudit.basis: Review the diff, exact-stage cutover receipt, native-only policy, historical evidence boundaries and rollback identity.
parentAudit.recovery: Stop mutation, retain the failed receipt and restore the last known native source if identity, state or provider agreement is uncertain.

completionCriteria: No current policy accepts a DocsBuild create, update or noop.
Any one-time delete has exact preflight, postcondition and non-claims.
Current source and policy no longer contain the legacy resource surface.
Historical evidence remains intact and outside current admission.

tasks.title: Make sibling docs packages native Alchemy build inputs
tasks.goal: Ensure Alchemy rebuilds when docs-content or docs-fumadocs source changes.
tasks.implementationPrompt: Use only the installed beta.64 option shape. Prove that a change in each sibling package changes the Alchemy input/memo result. Keep Fumadocs generation shared across TanStack client/server environments and preserve the documented injection guard.
mandatoryVerification: Focused typecheck for alchemy.run.ts and apps/docs
Sibling-package input invalidation fixture or deterministic equivalent
browserVerification: Run the existing built Cloudflare/workerd browser proof on the exact candidate and confirm changed authored content is served.
qualityAudits: Review the Alchemy/Vite ownership boundary and confirm no duplicate Cloudflare plugin stack.
Review sibling package paths, lockfile coverage and generated-source ownership.
Review the Effect/runtime boundary for any new Promise or process access.

parentAudit.basis: Review the memo diff, invalidation proof, build output and docs runtime proof against the target call graph.
parentAudit.recovery: Revert or re-scope the memo change if the installed beta.64 types or generated build disagree with the intended input boundary.

completionCriteria: Both sibling packages and the lockfile are explicit Alchemy build inputs.
A sibling source change invalidates the build input.
Built Worker/browser proof passes without legacy build orchestration.

tasks.title: Unify Preview mutation locking
tasks.goal: Prevent Preview deploy and PR-close teardown from mutating the same stage concurrently.
tasks.implementationPrompt: Use one exact pr-N concurrency key in Preview and teardown. Keep Production separate and protected. Do not broaden the Cloudflare credential or change the active teardown environment without its separate plan and readback.
mandatoryVerification: Static byte-for-byte equality check for the two concurrency groups
qualityAudits: Review the lock key, cancellation policy, environment binding and stage expression together.
Review that documentation no longer claims a lock that the workflows do not implement.
Review the diff for Production, credential, provider-state or unrelated workflow changes.

parentAudit.basis: Review workflow diff, contract test, architecture/runbook owners and active teardown-plan dependency.
parentAudit.recovery: Restore the last known lock configuration and keep teardown blocked if exact stage or environment identity is uncertain.

completionCriteria: Preview and teardown use the exact same non-cancellable stage lock.
The contract test fails if either expression diverges.
Current architecture and runbook claims match the workflow.

tasks.title: Consolidate native plan projection and retire compatibility parsing
tasks.goal: Use one current native plan projection and remove duplicated legacy-aware shell logic.
tasks.implementationPrompt: Do not invent an unsupported Alchemy structured-plan API. If beta.64 exposes no suitable structured output, retain one tightly scoped text adapter with explicit version fixtures and reject every unknown line. Remove duplicated workflow projections and all current DocsBuild branches.
mandatoryVerification: Plan fixture tests for create, update, noop, delete and unknown resources
Current active-surface search for DocsBuild and Command.Build
qualityAudits: Review the parser as a host adapter, not a domain model.
Review Schema decoding, redaction, receipt identity and fail-closed behaviour.
Review for duplicated shell parsing, raw JSON ingress and helper/wrapper sprawl.

parentAudit.basis: Review the parser implementation, fixtures, receipt schemas, workflow call graph and negative search evidence.
parentAudit.recovery: Keep the old parser quarantined or re-scope to a smaller fixture-backed adapter if the installed Alchemy output cannot be safely represented.

completionCriteria: All current workflows use one native plan projection contract.
Unknown plan resources fail closed.
No current receipt schema or test admits DocsBuild or Command.Build.

tasks.title: Close documentation, evidence and verification
tasks.goal: Align every current owner, preserve history and prove the final hard-cutover boundary.
tasks.implementationPrompt: Update the earliest durable owner in the same slice. Do not rewrite historical evidence. Re-read the SPEC, tasks, architecture and runbook together, then reopen any finding affected by implementation discoveries before closeout.
mandatoryVerification: Fresh review of the final call graph, active-surface search, authority limits, rollback and non-claims
browserVerification: Run exact-candidate built and hosted browser proof only when separately authorised; record local, provider and hosted claims separately.
qualityAudits: Review the final SPEC/task/plan, architecture, runbook, README and automation register for contradiction.
Review historical receipts for preservation and current-admission exclusion.
Review all Effect and provider boundaries for direct env/process access, unchecked values, raw clients, unmanaged concurrency and duplicate runtimes.

parentAudit.basis: Review the complete diff, task gates, current owners, historical evidence, terminal receipt and exact verification outputs.
parentAudit.recovery: Reopen the affected task and owner, correct or re-scope the change, and seek authority when provider or hosted proof cannot be obtained safely.

completionCriteria: The current graph, workflows, schemas, policy, docs and task lifecycle agree.
No current DocsBuild or Command.Build deployment surface remains.
Historical evidence remains immutable and clearly bounded.
All required local checks pass and external claims are separately receipt-bound.
No package publication, provider mutation or deployment is implied by local completion.
